report.summary: Reviewed chunk 3 of 4 of dss.py: diffusion logic, config, context plan, receipt. Claims about diffusion behavior, config validation, context plan enforcement, and receipt provenance are checked against visible code.
risks: diffuse_relation_scores line 564-601 | medium | Decay factor uses `decay ** hop` which can underflow for large steps; no check for numerical stability. | Verify if underflow is acceptable or if a minimum threshold should be applied.

build_context_plan line 673-719 | low | Comment claims '_relation_adjacencies keeps diffusion file-to-file, so a type node has no path into fused' but fused is not defined in this chunk. | Verify fused variable and diffusion path constraints.

handoff.purpose: Contains diffusion scoring, DSS configuration, context plan builder, and receipt dataclass.

symbols.name: diffuse_relation_scores
symbols.note: Diffuses scores along edges and hyperedges using iterative propagation with decay.

symbols.name: DEFAULT_RELATION_WEIGHTS
symbols.note: Tuple of relation-weight pairs used as default in DSSConfig.

symbols.name: DSSConfig
symbols.note: Frozen dataclass for DSS configuration with validation in __post_init__.

symbols.name: DSSConfig.weights
symbols.note: Returns relation weights as a dictionary.

symbols.name: DSSConfig.to_dict
symbols.note: Serializes config to dictionary with sorted relation weights.

symbols.name: ContextItem
symbols.note: Frozen dataclass for a single context item with node_id, score, estimated_tokens, reasons.

symbols.name: ContextItem.to_dict
symbols.note: Serializes ContextItem to dictionary with reasons as list.

symbols.name: ContextPlan
symbols.note: Frozen dataclass for context plan with token budget, used, selected, omitted.

symbols.name: ContextPlan.to_dict
symbols.note: Serializes ContextPlan to dictionary including nested items.

symbols.name: _estimated_tokens
symbols.note: Estimates token count from explicit mapping or node attributes, fallback to loc*8.

symbols.name: build_context_plan
symbols.note: Greedily packs file nodes into token budget; raises on non-file node kinds.

symbols.name: DSSReceipt
symbols.note: Frozen dataclass for content-addressed provenance of DSS result.

symbols.name: DSSReceipt.to_dict
symbols.note: Serializes receipt to dictionary with sorted input_sha256 and relation_channels.

symbols.name: DSSReceipt.content_sha256
symbols.note: Returns SHA256 of the receipt dictionary via _digest.

symbols.name: DSSReceipt.envelope
symbols.note: Returns receipt dictionary with added receipt_sha256 key.

claims.text: Diffuse scores independently along every edge and hyperedge relation.
claims.why: The function iterates over all relations from _relation_adjacencies and processes each independently.
The adjacency loop only iterates from source to target, no reverse propagation.

claims.text: Hyperedges use explicit member-to-group-to-member message passing, represented here by an equivalent normalised transition for computation; the Forest itself is never rewritten as a clique.
claims.why: The claim about hyperedge representation and Forest not being rewritten depends on _relation_adjacencies which is not in this chunk.

claims.text: diffusion decay must be at most 1

claims.why: Lines 629-632 check for duplicate relation names and raise ValueError.

claims.text: token cost for ... must be positive

claims.why: Lines 706-708 raise KeyError if node_id not in kinds.

claims.text: Forest node ID ... is not a packable node kind
claims.why: Lines 709-713 raise KeyError if kind not in FILE_NODE_KINDS.

claims.text: This fallback cannot fail, so for a node with no bytes on disk it does not report a gap, it reports 8 tokens. The guard upstream is what keeps that number honest -- do not relax it here.
claims.why: The claim about upstream guard and behavior for nodes with no bytes on disk cannot be verified from this chunk alone.

claims.text: Refusing loudly rather than skipping quietly is the same posture restrict_scores and semantic_super_sample already take on their own inputs.
claims.why: restrict_scores and semantic_super_sample are not defined in this chunk.

claims.text: _relation_adjacencies keeps diffusion file-to-file, so a type node has no path into fused.
claims.why: _relation_adjacencies and fused are not in this chunk.

claims.text: That makes this the SECOND lock on the door, and the one that turns a regression in the first into a stack trace instead of a fabricated cost.
claims.why: Refers to a first lock not present in this chunk.

observations.what: diffuse_relation_scores uses decay ** hop which may underflow for large steps; no numerical stability guard.
build_context_plan references FILE_NODE_KINDS which is not defined in this chunk.
build_context_plan docstring mentions restrict_scores, semantic_super_sample, fused which are not in this chunk.
DSSReceipt uses RECEIPT_SCHEMA_VERSION which is not defined in this chunk.
DSSReceipt.envelope method is incomplete; ends abruptly without closing brace.
DSSConfig.weights returns dict(self.relation_weights) which will overwrite duplicate keys silently if any; but __post_init__ prevents duplicates.
